items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: Benny Goodman had promised me he was gonna record me, an' he did, and I ain't sung the first number.

ctx.x: When you were at Cafe Society?
When I was at Cafe Society. I went to the studio and ever'thing. Benny Goodman had promised me he was gonna record me, an' he did, and I ain't sung the first number.
